# apple_subscription_group (Resource)

Manages a group of auto-renewable subscriptions, of which a customer can have one at a time. Set its customer-facing name with `apple_subscription_group_localization`. Destroying the resource deletes a group without subscriptions that was never approved. Import it with `<app_id>/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_subscription_group" "pro" {
  app_id         = data.apple_app.example.id
  reference_name = "Pro"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `reference_name` (String) Reference name, seen only in App Store Connect; up to 64 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_subscription_group.pro
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
    id     = "21000000"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription group.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_subscription_group.pro 1234567890/21000000
```
